# Logpush Connectors



> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Enable destinations](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/index.md): Configure Logpush to send logs to a destination.

## Enable Cloudflare R2

- [Enable Cloudflare R2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/r2/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Cloudflare R2.

## Enable Basin Pipelines

- [Enable Basin Pipelines](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/pipelines/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Basin Pipelines.

## Enable HTTP destination

- [Enable HTTP destination](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/http/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to a custom HTTP endpoint.

## Enable Amazon S3

- [Enable Amazon S3](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/aws-s3/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Amazon S3.

## Enable S3-compatible endpoints

- [Enable S3-compatible endpoints](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/s3-compatible-endpoints/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to S3-compatible storage.

## Enable Datadog

- [Enable Datadog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/datadog/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Datadog.

## Enable Elastic

- [Enable Elastic](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/elastic/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Elastic.

## Enable Google Cloud Storage

- [Enable Google Cloud Storage](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/google-cloud-storage/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Google Cloud Storage.

## Enable Google BigQuery

- [Enable Google BigQuery](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/bigquery/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Google BigQuery.

## Enable Microsoft Azure

- [Enable Microsoft Azure](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/azure/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Microsoft Azure Blob Storage.

## Enable New Relic

- [Enable New Relic](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/new-relic/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to New Relic.

## Enable SentinelOne

- [Enable SentinelOne](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/sentinelone/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to SentinelOne Data Lake.

## Enable Splunk

- [Enable Splunk](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/splunk/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Splunk via HEC.

## Enable Sumo Logic

- [Enable Sumo Logic](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/sumo-logic/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to Sumo Logic.

## Enable IBM QRadar

- [Enable IBM QRadar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/ibm-qradar/index.md): Learn about enable ibm qradar in Cloudflare Logs.

## Enable Amazon Kinesis

- [Enable Amazon Kinesis](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/kinesis/index.md): Learn about enable amazon kinesis in Cloudflare Logs.

## Enable IBM Cloud Logs

- [Enable IBM Cloud Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/ibm-cloud-logs/index.md): Push Cloudflare logs to IBM Cloud Logs.

## Enable other providers

- [Enable other providers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/other-providers/index.md): Learn about enable other providers in Cloudflare Logs.

## Dedicated Egress IP for Logpush

- [Dedicated Egress IP for Logpush](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/egress-ip/index.md): Send Logpush logs via a dedicated egress IP.
